caption: A 10 μm panel pixel 4 cm behind a 5 cm lens becomes a virtual image 20 cm away and 5 times larger, so that pixel subtends 0.86 arcmin — right at the eye's 1 arcmin limit. The combiner adds a see-through path from the real world to the same eye, which is the AR case.

spec.aria: Light from a microdisplay 4 cm behind a lens of focal length 5 cm forms a virtual image 20 cm away and 5 times larger; the eye focuses on that image, where one 10 micrometre pixel subtends 0.86 arcmin, and a combiner also sends real-world light to the same eye.
